subject: Brazil vendor tax setup & invoice routing (CNPJ / NFe) - onboarding steps
messages:
From: Felipe Costa <felipe.costa@bramazon.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: contabilidade@bramazon.com
Date: 2026-08-12T09:15:00-03:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: what tax docs / invoice format do you need for Brazil?

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the heads up on the PO. We need to complete Redwood's vendor setup before we can submit the first invoice. A couple of quick questions so our AP team issues the correct document: 

- Do you require an NFe (nota fiscal eletrônica) XML attachment for service invoices, or is a PDF invoice with CNPJ + service description sufficient?
- Any required fields we must include on the invoice (PO number format, CNPJ in a specific field, tax breakdowns)?
- Do you need a Brazilian tax representative for withholding or any Redwood-specific vendor form?

I'll attach our standard invoice template if helpful. We are ready to provide CNPJ, bank info (Banco do Brasil), and the NFe file if needed.

Best,
Felipe
Vendor Ops | BrAmazon Logistics
contabilidade@bramazon.com

Attachment: bramazon-invoice-template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Felipe Costa <felipe.costa@bramazon.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-13T10:20:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: what tax docs / invoice format do you need for Brazil?

Hi Felipe — thanks for reaching out. Short answers and next steps below.

Requirements (Brazilian vendors supplying services to Redwood US entity):
- Primary ID: we need the vendor CNPJ on every invoice (format: 00.000.000/0000-00)
- Invoice file: PDF invoice is acceptable for our AP flow, but please also attach the corresponding NFe XML when available (we store the XML for audit).
- PO mapping: include our PO number exactly as PO-84237 in the invoice header and the invoice "reference / order" field.
- Taxes: show gross amount and tax lines (ISS, PIS/COFINS if applicable). If taxes are withheld in BR, include the withholding breakdown so our tax team can reconcile.
- Bank details: provide beneficiary name (must match CNPJ), bank, branch, account (no screenshots).

Action items for BrAmazon:
1) Complete the attached Redwood vendor onboarding form and sign page 2 (PDF).
2) Send one sample invoice for PO-84237 with CNPJ and attach the NFe XML (if already issued).
3) Confirm whether you are billing from the Brazilian legal entity (provide legal name exactly as registered).

I attached: redwood-vendor-onboarding-form.pdf and a short sample invoice PDF (redwood-invoice-sample-br.pdf) that shows our preferred field mapping.

If anything is unclear, we can do a 15-min screen-share with AP.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-vendor-onboarding-form.pdf, redwood-invoice-sample-br.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-14T08:05:00-04:00
Subject: Internal: BR vendor — reverse-charge / withholding?

Soojin — quick note after reviewing Felipe's template. A couple of points before we confirm to vendor:

- Confirm legal invoicing entity: if BrAmazon is billing from a non-US affiliate but the service delivery is in Brazil, we typically do not withhold US taxes, but we need the W-8BEN-E if any US-sourced payments could trigger withholding. Ask them to provide W-8BEN-E only if they will invoice our US entity.
- Accounting mapping: Dev, can you confirm our AP ingestion will accept NFe XML in the attachments field and map CNPJ to vendor_tax_id? Also confirm we can parse ISS vs service amount for accruals.

If parsing is tricky, we can accept PDF + structured metadata in our vendor portal for now. I'll approve sending onboarding form.

-M

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Felipe Costa <felipe.costa@bramazon.com>
Cc: contabilidade@bramazon.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-15T16:42:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: what tax docs / invoice format do you need for Brazil?

Hi Felipe — great, thanks for the quick responses this week. A couple of confirmations to keep things moving: 

- Please complete and sign the attached redwood-vendor-onboarding-form.pdf and return it to procurement@redwood.com.
- For the first invoice against PO-84237, send: (1) a PDF invoice with CNPJ displayed prominently, (2) the NFe XML as an attachment, and (3) bank details matching the CNPJ legal name.
- If you will invoice the Redwood US entity, attach a completed W-8BEN-E (our tax team will confirm whether withholding applies). If billing a non-US affiliate, W-8 is not necessary but include the local tax registration docs.

Attached I am sending a redwood invoice example for Brazil and a small sample NFe XML extracted from a supplier (sample-NFe.xml) to show our AP how we ingest the file.

Next steps:
- Felipe: return onboarding form + sample invoice by EOD Wednesday (2026-08-18).
- AP (contabilidade): include NFe XML with invoice submission; reference PO-84237 in the header.

If you'd prefer, we can schedule a 15-min call Monday to walk through the sample XML (I can loop in Dev).

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-vendor-onboarding-form.pdf, sample-NFe.xml, redwood-invoice-sample-br.pdf
